name: RadioGroup
summary: A group of radio options with a label, a description and an error, that keeps the chosen value — vertical or horizontal. RadioGroup.Item is the Radio.

a11y.keyboardNote: role=radiogroup named by the label; description and error in aria-describedby. The options are native radios sharing one name: Tab enters on the chosen one, the arrows move and choose, Space chooses.

props.name: label
props.description: REQUIRED. The group's visible name — what the screen reader announces for the group.

props.name: labelHidden
props.description: Keeps the group name in the DOM but out of sight, as the Checkbox does: the options start at the top, without the 16 that separated them from the name.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the label, joined to the group by aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: The error at the end; marks every option invalid.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The chosen option's value: controlled, or where it starts.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the value of the option chosen.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of every option, for a form.

props.name: orientation
props.description: vertical stacks the options with 16 before each; horizontal puts them in a row with 16 between them, as the reference.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Paints every option invalid, as the native invalid; error already does it.

props.name: required
props.description: The asterisk on the label, and required on the options.

props.name: variant
props.description: card makes each option a whole card (the card skin: radius 22, the card padding and fill), 12 apart; the chosen card rises 4 with a large shadow and the selected-tab fill. The same name as the native RadioGroup. Still for people who ask for less motion; the focus ring goes around the whole card.

props.name: indicatorPlacement
props.description: On the web the dot sits at the start. none removes it, only with variant="card", where the card itself shows the choice; the option is still a native radio inside.

props.name: RadioGroup.Item
props.description: The option: the Radio (value, label, description, disabled).
